title: Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization: Unified Learning from Offline Demonstrations and On- and Off-Policy Rollouts via a Shared Regression Target
abstract: arXiv:2610.12830v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reasoning post-training draws on offline demonstrations and policy-generated rollouts, yet conventional supervised fine-tuning (SFT) followed by reinforcement learning (RL) separates their objectives and limits continued reuse of collected responses. We propose \textbf{Cross-Behavior Policy Optimization} (CBPO), which makes these sources compatible with one regression loss through a fixed-reference target. Because the generating policy does not enter this target, positive and negative offline completions, reference responses, and current and historical rollouts can share a common reward-labeled record format and replay buffer. As new responses enter the buffer, optimization retains the same regression objective without coordinating separate SFT and RL objectives or requiring stored behavior-policy probabilities, importance weighting, or a learned critic. Restricting the available sources gives offline, on-policy, and off-policy variants,

translated_title: 跨行为策略优化：通过共享回归目标从离线演示与在策略及离策略采样中实现统一学习
translated_abstract: 推理后训练依赖离线演示数据和策略生成的采样数据，然而传统的先监督微调（SFT）后强化学习（RL）的方法将两者的目标分离，并限制了已收集回复的持续复用。我们提出跨行为策略优化（CBPO），通过固定参考目标使这些数据源能够兼容于同一种回归损失。由于生成策略不进入该目标，正负离线补全、参考回复以及当前与历史采样数据可以共享统一的奖励标注记录格式和经验回放缓冲区。随着新回复进入缓冲区，优化始终保持相同的回归目标，无需协调分离的SFT和RL目标，也无需存储行为策略概率、重要性加权或学习评论家网络。通过限制可用的数据源，可以得到离线、在策略和离策略等变体。
tldr: CBPO通过固定参考的共享回归目标，将离线演示、在策略与离策略采样统一到同一回归损失和回放缓冲区中，无需分别协调SFT与RL目标、重要性加权或评论家网络即可实现数据的持续复用与统一学习。
en_tdlr: CBPO unifies learning from offline demonstrations and on-/off-policy rollouts through a fixed-reference shared regression target, enabling a common reward-labeled replay buffer without separate SFT/RL objectives, stored behavior-policy probabilities, importance weighting, or a learned critic.
